reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the batch report on the page is exactly what I look for. At $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee, I'll try one box and see if I actually sleep better.
objection: I can't check that the lab report is real until the box arrives, and it is only one box, so I can't tell if it works. I'd also want to see that the lab and the batch number are genuine.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report wasn't actually on the page, or the batch didn't match, I'd skip it.
